Theorem
[Euler--Lagrange equations] 1. ch3:3.3-thm-1\group Calculus of Variations If $x(\cdot )$ minimizes $I$ among the admissible curves, then \[ -\frac d{ds}D_qL(\dot x(s),x(s))+D_xL(\dot x(s),x(s))=0. \]

Proof

\sketch For variations $x+\tau v$ with $v(0)=v(t)=0$, differentiating at $\tau =0$ gives the first variation. Integration by parts and the fundamental lemma of the calculus of variations yield the displayed system.

□
